definitions.explanation: A weight hung from a fixed point so that it swings freely back and forth, as in a clock; also used figuratively for something that swings between two extremes.

examples.japanese: {振|ふ}り{子|こ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れている→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。

examples.english: There is an old pendulum clock in my grandfather's house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧{振|ふ}り{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: In science class, we changed the length of the string and studied how the pendulum moved.

notes:
From ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to swing) + ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (a small thing). In compounds the first sound of ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ changes: {振|ふ}り{子|こ}{時計|どけい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {振|ふ}り{子|こ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧: a pendulum swings
- {振|ふ}り{子|こ}{時計|どけい}: pendulum clock
- {振|ふ}り{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原理|げんり}→原理：00066_genri⟧: the principle of the pendulum
- {振|ふ}り{子|こ}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧: back and forth like a pendulum (of opinion, policy, mood)
